description: Defines a TpTimer class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, implementing a timer with start, stop, and callback functionalities, including an inner class TpTimerJob for job management.

classes.name: TpTimer
classes.description: A timer class providing start, stop, interval, and callback functionalities, with support for single-shot and recurring timers.

classes.name: TpTimerJob
classes.description: Inner class representing a timer job, managing execution and comparison based on the associated TpTimer instance.

methods.name: TpTimer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer with default interval and state.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and revokes scheduled jobs.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with the current interval.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with a specified interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setSingleShot
methods.description: Sets whether the timer is single-shot or recurring.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the timer interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a callback function to be called on timer timeout.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Internal method invoked when the timer elapses, executing the callback and managing timer state.
